fact: Angola Telecom's executive said the SARSSy subsea system, a partnership with Telecom Namibia with landings in five Angolan provinces and a link to Equiano at Swakopmund, is due to operate in June 2027, and that a terrestrial fibre link between the two countries (Santa Clara-Ondjiva) already exists.
title: Angola Telecom prevê operação do cabo submarino SARSSy até 2027
